metadata.name: GetPortfolioIDHistory
metadata.description: This API fetches history of Portfolio IDs for the account.

children.description: Merchant Name which is assigned to a Merchant Valid Values:A-Z Format: XXXXXX Example: ABCD LLC Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ProductName
children.description: Reflects the name of product for the account Valid Values: a-z Format: xxxxxx Example: abcsolutionsrevolving Allowable Values: 50

children.name: InstitutionID
children.description: Unique identification number for Institution Valid  Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX Example: Fixed value needs to pass which is provided by Corecard.

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example: 7314145404 Condition: At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 19

children.name: FirstName
children.description: Card holder's First name. Valid Values: A-Z Format:XXXXX Example:User1 Allowable Values: 40

children.name: LastName
children.description: Card holder's last name. Valid Values:A-Z Format:XXXXX Example:Smith Allowable Values: 40

children.name: PortfolioID
children.description: Portfolio Id assigned on account Valid Values: Valid Portfolio ID value Format: XXXX Example: Midland Allowable Values: 100

children.name: PIDEffectiveDateTime
children.description: Date Time stamp when PID was effective on the account Valid Values: Valid date Format: mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss Example: 01/17/2017 12:40:40

children.name: PortfolioDescription
children.description: A string field providing brief description of Portfolio ID Valid Values: a-z Format: XXXXXX Example: Midland States Bank for ABC Allowable Values: 200

children.name: LocationID
children.description: Related to Portfolio ID associated with account. Indicates location ID. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX Example: 10 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: ReceivableOwner
children.description: Collateral ID to track legal receivable ownership of the Account. Valid Values: Collateral ID set as Receivable Owner on the PorfolioID of the Account. Example: Midland Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AccountOwner
children.description: Collateral ID setup as 'Account Owner' of the Porfolio ID set on the Account. Valid Values: Collateral ID set as Receivable Owner on the PorfolioID of the Account. Example: Midland Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PlanSegmentID
children.description: Description: Indicates the unique ID generated for each plan segment added to an account. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:98756775

children.description: It displays Account Collateral ID History

children.name: UserID
children.description: The ID of the user who made the change. Valid Values:0-9,A-Z Format:XXXX

children.name: InstitutionID
children.description: Unique identification number for Institution Valid  Values:0-9 Format: XXXX Example: Fixed value needs to pass which is provided by Corecard.

children.name: AccountCIDEffectiveDateTime
children.description: Date Time stamp when Account Collateral ID was effective on the Account Valid Values: Valid date Format: mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm:ss Example: 01/17/2017 12:40:40

children.name: AccountCollateralID
children.description: Collateral ID to track legal ownership of account separately from receivable ownership at Portfolio ID. Valid Values: Valid Collateral ID set as Account Owner on Portfolio ID. Example: Midland Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AccountCollateralIDDescription
children.description: A string field providing brief description of Account Collateral ID Valid Values: a-z Format: XXXXXX Example: Midland States Bank for ABC Allowable Values: 200
